create_ACTOR_instance: create an Actor instance with an agent, environment, unroll length, and learner for IMPALA training
run_ACTOR_unroll: run an unroll of agent environment steps and return the trajectory as a Transition object
run_ACTOR_unroll_and_push: run one unroll of agent steps and enqueue the resulting trajectory to the learner
pull_ACTOR_params: pull the latest network parameters from the learner for the actor to use
review_ACTOR_class: review the Actor class that manages a single agent environment interaction loop in IMPALA
